## Browser journal diagnostics

JournalAdapterError codes are registered in model/browser-diagnostics.toml and owned by DK-12. Known propagated BrowserEffectError codes retain the SPEC section 12.1 namespace. Private defensive-boundary tests do not claim those invalid internal values are public journeys.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author-mismatch` | The signed event author does not match the actual P-256 public-key principal. |
| `event-id-mismatch` | The event ID differs from the SHA-256 digest of its generated domain-separated signing preimage. |
| `generated-execution-failed` | The trusted generated journal guest could not execute; no candidate state is promoted. |
| `invalid-generated-module` | The trusted bootstrap did not provide a WebAssembly module with the required journal exports. |
| `invalid-generated-output` | The generated output framing, bounds or completion binding is invalid. |
| `invalid-hash` | A trusted-boundary content reference is not a canonical lowercase SHA-256 identifier. |
| `invalid-input` | The public journal call has an invalid argument count or head name. |
| `invalid-length` | An internal framing length is not an unsigned integer representable in 24 bits. |
| `journal-busy` | The local host already owns two outstanding append/refresh operations; additional work is rejected before input capture or effects. |
| `model-rejected` | The generated model rejected the candidate; detail carries only its bounded rejection bytes. |
| `object-corrupt` | Retained event or head bytes differ from their exact content identifier. |
| `object-missing` | Complete authenticated replay cannot fetch a referenced retained event object. |
| `replay-required` | A failed or uncertain outcome requires complete authenticated replay before another write. |
| `request-limit` | An internal guest request exceeds the modeled allocation cap before guest execution. |
| `signature-invalid` | Actual browser cryptography rejects the context-bound event signature. |
| `storage-outcome-unknown` | The trusted storage adapter returned an unrecognized exception; its message, payload and cause are discarded and replay is required. |
| `storage-rejected` | The generated completion bound an actual storage conflict or failure; detail carries only the modeled status byte. |
| `storage-result-mismatch` | The real storage call returned a head other than the exact candidate; no promotion or retry occurs before replay. |

## CommandAdapterError diagnostics

Registered in model/browser-adapter-diagnostics.toml; owned by DK-13. JournalAdapterError and BrowserEffectError remain separate propagated namespaces. Negative-only guard tests are not public journeys.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `adapter-busy` | Two operations are already owned; additional work is rejected before intent capture. |
| `adapter-closed` | The adapter is closed; captured or late work cannot expose a result or begin a new effect. |
| `command-rejected` | The generated Command rejected the operation; detail is exactly its registered one-byte failure. |
| `commit-outcome-unknown` | Close occurred during an already started durable write; no rollback is claimed and reopening must replay. |
| `generated-execution-failed` | The trusted generated guest trapped or could not execute; no successful result is exposed. |
| `identity-missing` | The private storage namespace has no persisted identity. |
| `invalid-effect-result` | A trusted-boundary hash is not a canonical lowercase SHA-256 identifier. |
| `invalid-generated-module` | Trusted bootstrap did not provide the expected import-free generated module and exports. |
| `invalid-generated-output` | Generated output framing, bounds or required fields are invalid. |
| `invalid-input` | The call has an invalid argument count, closed intent shape, type or byte bound. |
| `refresh-required` | A failed or uncertain command requires explicit complete authenticated replay before another write. |
| `request-limit` | The private guest request exceeds the exact modeled allocation cap before guest execution. |
| `storage-outcome-unknown` | An unknown storage exception is replaced by a stable code without retaining its message, payload or cause. |

The `command-rejected` detail is the exact generated byte:

| Byte | Modeled rejection |
|---|---|
| 1 | `BadEncoding` |
| 2 | `InvalidCommand` |
| 3 | `InvalidHead` |
| 4 | `WorkspaceMismatch` |
| 5 | `EventLimit` |
| 6 | `WrongPhase` |
| 7 | `CorrelationMismatch` |
| 8 | `StaleHead` |
| 9 | `EffectMismatch` |
| 10 | `InvalidResult` |
| 11 | `UnknownOperation` |
| 12 | `InvalidPending` |

## ViewHostError diagnostics

Registered separately in model/browser-view-diagnostics.toml; owned by DK-16. Private defensive guards are distinct from public journeys. Journal and Command/Query namespaces are unchanged.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `generated-execution-failed` | The private generated View guest trapped or failed execution; no successful transition is exposed. |
| `host-unavailable` | Bootstrap or private execution failed; the public boundary exposes no exception payload and an opened View terminalizes and clears its display. |
| `invalid-effect-result` | A private admitted Query result has invalid fields or bounds and cannot become generated presentation. |
| `invalid-generated-module` | Trusted bootstrap did not provide the exact import-free guest contract. |
| `invalid-generated-output` | A private generated transition, effect or presentation violates its registered framing or bounds. |
| `invalid-input` | A public dispatch or close call has invalid arity, type or byte bounds; no input is asynchronously recaptured. |
| `invalid-labels` | The modeled labels artifact is not the closed canonical UTF-8 JSON schema within its exact byte limits. |
| `invalid-root` | The private renderer did not receive a connected same-realm HTML element. |
| `model-rejected` | The generated View rejected the operation with exactly one registered rejection byte; no replacement state or effect is accepted. |
| `request-limit` | The private generated View input exceeds its fixed allocation cap before guest execution. |
| `view-closed` | The View is terminal; public dispatch cannot begin work or restore presentation. |

The model-rejected detail is the exact generated byte:

| Byte | Modeled rejection |
|---|---|
| 1 | `BadEncoding` |
| 2 | `InvalidState` |
| 3 | `InvalidIntent` |
| 4 | `Busy` |
| 5 | `ReplayRequired` |
| 6 | `Closed` |
| 7 | `CounterExhausted` |
| 8 | `NoSelection` |
| 9 | `NoNextPage` |
| 10 | `WrongPhase` |
| 11 | `CorrelationMismatch` |
| 12 | `InvalidOutcome` |
| 13 | `InvalidPage` |
| 14 | `UnknownOperation` |
